Openings bottom band first, ribbon convention (an oriel's three facets, split by colonnettes under 0.3 m, are one opening).

facades.name: Leidsestraat front
facades.note: Bands: the shop windows (a delivery truck hides the second and third bays: null); the mezzanine ribbon of each of the three bays; the first and second oriel storeys, one canted oriel per bay; the loggia storey, nine lights between the brick posts. The level cornice and balustrade have no peak. Cropped (alongM) to the 14.79 m front from the party wall; the chamfer tower beyond it faces the corner.

facades.name: canal front
facades.note: Bands: the shop storey (hidden by the quay wall: null); the mezzanine ribbon in each of the four bays; the first and second oriel storeys, three canted oriels and the flat bay at the east end; the loggia storey (a tree hides its east half: null). Cropped (alongM) from the corner: the chamfer tower and its return face the corner, not the canal. The flat bay's pair of windows is split by a stone mullion under 0.3 m: one opening.
